title: Supademo vs Navattic vs Storylane vs Karumi: which demo tool fits in 2026?
summary: Supademo, Navattic, Storylane and Karumi compared for 2026: recorded tour or live AI agent, prices as of November 2026, voice and chat, and who each fits.
body_markdown:
Supademo, Navattic and Storylane build interactive demos from screens you capture, and each now sells an AI agent on top; Karumi is an AI demo agent that shows your real product live, by voice or chat. Pick Supademo for many demo formats at a low entry price, Navattic for high-fidelity HTML demos on your website, Storylane for tours plus a website agent priced by traffic, and Karumi when buyers ask questions that a capture cannot answer.


Karumi is an AI demo agent: an autonomous agent that shows a buyer your real product live, by voice or chat, and answers questions as it goes. We build Karumi, so we compete with all three. Every price below comes from each vendor's own pricing page, checked on 19 November 2026.

## Recorded tour or live agent: what is the real difference?


A recorded tour, or interactive demo, replays screens your team captured. The buyer clicks through a path someone built. An AI agent on top can answer questions and route the buyer to the right demo, but it shows what was captured or set up for it.


A live AI demo agent works in the product itself. When a buyer asks "can it do this?", it opens the screen that answers the question, even if nobody prepared that path.


Question Recorded tour with an agent Live AI demo agent


Time to set up Minutes to hours for a first tour About two weeks for most Karumi teams


A question nobody planned for Answered from your content, or sent to sales Answered and shown in the product


After a product release Recapture the steps that changed The agent uses the current product; check its flows after big releases


Same for every visitor? Yes, with tokens and branches No, it follows each buyer


Best place Feature pages, launches, help content Demo requests, outbound links, live calls


Read[live vs pre-recorded AI demo agents](https://karumi.ai/blog/live-vs-pre-recorded-ai-demo-agents) and[agentic demos vs interactive demos](https://karumi.ai/blog/agentic-demos-vs.-interactive-demos) for the long version.


## When is Supademo the right choice?


Supademo is the most flexible tool here and the cheapest to start. It keeps screenshot, video, HTML and sandbox demos in one library. Its AI Demo Agent "runs structured discovery and guides users to the most relevant content", by voice or text, and it is self-serve with published credit prices, so you can try it without a sales call.


Choose Supademo when many teams (marketing, sales, onboarding and support) need demos and budget matters. Its limit: the agent guides buyers through demos and content you prepared, so a question outside them goes to your team. Read[Karumi vs Supademo](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-supademo) .


## When is Navattic the right choice?


Navattic captures your product as HTML, so its demos look and behave close to the real app. Its pricing page lists Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo and 25+ more integrations from Base, AI avatars (100 minutes on Base, 300 on Growth) and sandbox demos on Growth. Navattic says its agents "answer buyer questions in their own words and navigate your product or content live, 24/7 and in any language" ([Navattic](https://www.navattic.com/blog/interactive-demos) , checked November 2026).


Choose Navattic when your website is your main conversion surface and marketing owns the demo program. Its limits: paid plans are billed annually, and agent pricing is by quote. Read[Karumi vs Navattic](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-navattic) and[Supademo vs Navattic](https://karumi.ai/blog/supademo-vs-navattic) .


## When is Storylane the right choice?


Storylane has a low entry price and a broad suite: tours, HTML demos from Growth, personalization tokens, A/B testing, Hubs and the RepX website agent. RepX handles voice and text chat with unlimited conversations, and sends leads and transcripts to HubSpot and Marketo. Every paid RepX plan comes with a 30-day free trial.


Choose Storylane when you want tours and a website agent from one vendor, priced by traffic. Its limits: Salesforce starts on Premium, and RepX cost follows your traffic, not the number of buyers who talk to it. Read[Karumi vs Storylane](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-storylane) and[Storylane vs Navattic](https://karumi.ai/blog/storylane-vs-navattic) .


## When is Karumi the right choice?


Choose Karumi when the product is complex, buyers come with their own checklist and the best answer is often "let me show you". The agent decides what to show in your real product and adapts to each buyer.


- **Live product.** Not a recording or a click-through tour.
- **Voice and chat, in the buyer's language.** A demo link can set the language.
- **Live calls.** Karumi[joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls) .
- **Outbound.** A live demo link goes into a cold email, pre-filled for the contact.
- **Booking and CRM.** The agent books the meeting with the right rep and syncs sessions to HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio.
- **Security.** The Enterprise plan includes SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR, and on-premise deployment.


Its limits: there is no free self-serve plan, prices are by quote, and a live-product agent needs a login and a short setup before it goes live. If your buyers only want a quick look at a simple product, a tour from one of the other three is enough.


## FAQ


### Which is cheapest: Supademo, Navattic, Storylane or Karumi?


Supademo has the lowest paid entry, at $38 per creator a month billed annually, and Storylane starts at $40 a month billed yearly, as of November 2026. Navattic's paid plans start at $500 a month billed annually. Karumi prices by quote.


### Do Supademo, Navattic and Storylane have AI demo agents?


Yes. Supademo sells an AI Demo Agent as a credit add-on, Navattic sells Navattic Agents by quote, and Storylane sells RepX by website traffic. All three talk by voice or chat.


### Which tool shows my real product live?


Karumi shows your real product live, by voice or chat. Navattic says its agents can also navigate your product live. Supademo's and Storylane's agents work from your captured demos and content.


### Is Navattic free?


Yes. Navattic has a free Starter plan with 1 seat and 1 HTML or media demo, as of November 2026. Paid plans start at $500 a month, billed annually.


### Can I use a tour tool and Karumi together?


Yes. Many teams keep a short tour on feature pages and use a live agent for demo requests and outbound. The tour shows the idea, and the agent answers the buyer's own questions.


### Which tool is best for sales teams?


For first demos with inbound leads, a live agent that books meetings fits best. For reps who send tours inside active deals, Navattic and Storylane both offer sales features such as account identification and buyer hubs.
